name: Web Repository Architecture
description: Architecture for the CALM web repository, covering the static web server that hosts repository assets and the validation workflow used to verify CALM models over HTTP.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who requests the web site and documentation assets from the local static server and runs validation workflows.

nodes.name: Nginx Static Web Server
nodes.description: The nginx container defined in compose.yaml that serves static repository content and CALM architecture assets over HTTP on port 8080.

nodes.name: Repository Static Content
nodes.description: The static content bundle exposed by the nginx server, including architecture JSON, patterns, standards, and documentation assets.

nodes.name: Architecture Validation Script
nodes.description: The shell script in scripts/validate-architecture.sh that runs CALM validation commands against the assets exposed by the static server.

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: The CALM CLI used by the validation script to validate architecture, pattern, standard, and control assets.

nodes.name: Docker Container
nodes.description: A container grouping that hosts the nginx web server and the static content assets for the repository.

relationships.description: Architects request the repository's static web site and assets from the nginx server over HTTP.
Run validation tests as an architect
The nginx server serves static repository assets from the repository content bundle.
The validation script invokes the CALM CLI to run validation commands against the exposed assets.
The CALM CLI validates architecture documents by loading them from the local nginx server over HTTP.
The Docker container groups the nginx web server and the repository static content assets.
